description: This file defines the class RequestForwardableException, a custom exception class within the OrangeHRM project. It extends PHP's Exception class and implements Symfony's HttpExceptionInterface, adding properties and methods specific to HTTP request forwarding, such as controller, attributes, query parameters, status code, and headers.

classes.name: RequestForwardableException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling request forwarding in the OrangeHRM application, with properties to manage controller, attributes, query parameters, status code, and headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with specified controller, attributes, and query parameters.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns the controller associated with the exception.

methods.name: setController
methods.description: Sets the controller for the exception.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attributes associated with the request.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the attributes for the request.
